    var qs = base.split('?')[1];

        var kv = p.split('=');
        ps[kv[0]] = kv[1];
    });
    var isStoryLB = base.indexOf('/story/leader-board') > -1;

    var apiPath = isStoryLB ? '/api/v1/story/leader-board' : '/api/v1/leader-board';
